snippet.title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection – Release Date Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection launches for Nintendo Switch 2 on Mar 13, 2026! 

Ride, befriend, raise, and battle with monsters in a vibrant and expansive world filled with a colorful cast of characters. Take to the skies in this thrilling story-rich, turn-based RPG set in the world of Monster Hunter.

#MonsterHunterStories3 #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoDirect
